requirements.statement: Users can sign in to the app via the platform's single sign-on

criteria.must: An unauthenticated user is presented with a sign-in flow before accessing the app
A user who completes sign-in successfully reaches the app's main screen
A user who is not signed in cannot view currency or rate data

requirements.statement: Users can search for or select a currency from a list of supported currencies

criteria.must: The app displays a list of supported currencies
The user can search/filter the currency list
The user can select a currency from the list

requirements.statement: Users can see the current exchange rate of the selected currency to USD

criteria.must: Selecting a currency displays its current exchange rate to USD
The displayed rate corresponds to the currency the user selected

requirements.statement: Users can see when the displayed rate was last updated

criteria.must: The rate view shows a last-updated date/timestamp
The last-updated indicator reflects the actual date the rate was refreshed (i.e. daily, not stale beyond one day)
